journey.name: Android parent-to-lesson preview
journey.description: Use only the test emulator, local Firebase emulators, mocked AI, a synthetic account and the repository-authored counting PDF.

actions.action: Launch LessonBooks on the selected test emulator.
Verify that the sign-in form and Create account button are visible.
Enter the synthetic email into the Email address field.
Enter the synthetic password into the Password field.
Tap Create account.
Verify that the parental consent screen is visible.
Tap Save choices.
Tap Save choices in the consent confirmation dialog.
Verify that the child profile form is visible.
Enter SampleFox into the Nickname field.
Tap Create profile for Year 1.
Verify that Choose a PDF is visible.
Tap Choose a PDF.
Select lessonbooks-counting.pdf from Downloads.
Verify that the generated lessons appear in the parent library.
Tap Review lesson for the first lesson.
Verify that the lesson title and first activity are visible in the native WebView.
Select Three and tap Check answer.
Verify that correct-answer feedback is visible.
Tap Approve this lesson.
Verify that the approval control shows Approved.
Tap Back to your library.
Tap Delete child and their books.
Confirm deletion in the dialog.
Verify that the child profile form is visible and the previous lessons are absent.
